items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: Joe died right after that, too. Louis buried him.

ctx.x: Louis said he hadn't seen Joe in about, uh, oh, God, 10 or 12 years.
And, uh, I forget when that was. Joe died right after that, too. Louis buried him. Louis's pretty good about things like that, you know.
So, uh, how long did you stay with Tush Johnson?

items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Ory said when he fired Joe Oliver... Oliver used to play with Ory's band, and Ory said he fired him and Papa Mutt took his place.

ctx.x: Like I say, I want to get on to Ory on the next tape. But get me up to this Liberty Band of Papa Mutt's. Had Mutt been playing with Ory when Ory was out here?

Oh, yeah. Papa Mutt and Ory had worked off and on all their life, I guess. Ory said when he fired Joe Oliver... Oliver used to play with Ory's band, and Ory said he fired him and Papa Mutt took his place.
That's what Ory said, he fired him?
